summary: VisionSys AI Inc, a Hebei-domiciled foreign private issuer (formerly TCTM Kids IT Education/Tarena), filed a 6-K reporting closing of a private placement under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, its US shelf-equivalent. On and before November 2, 2026, it issued 125,000,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.001 per share for US$125,000,000, revising a July 10, 2026 agreement originally priced at US$0.000734 for about US$91,750,000; an October 10, 2026 re-signing set the new price and left other terms unchanged. Consideration was payable in fiat or cryptocurrency at the Company's discretion; no advisor, board recommendation, or exchange ratio was disclosed. Massive dilution and token-settled funding are the watch items.
